summary: Jiji Oh, 50, of Houston TX, solo hiking at Devil's Causeway in the Flat Tops Wilderness descended the wrong trail and became disoriented with no cell service; lost 4 days in temps dropping into the 30s until found about 1 p.m. on day 4 by two fly fishermen (Ned Skinner, Richard Grant), who hiked her to her hotel; recovering from frostbite
responding_agency: none deployed — found and walked out by two fly fishermen
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE — 4-day ordeal; story published 2022-10-22, Oh already back in Texas by publication; found ~1 p.m. on day 4; no SAR deployment — injury + documented bystander rescue fit scope
